offering_description.value: Distributes swimming pool supplies, equipment, chemicals, and irrigation and landscape products to pool builders, service companies, and retailers. It buys from manufacturers and delivers through its branch network and online ordering.

primary_products.value: pool chemicals; pool equipment; pool parts and accessories; irrigation products; landscape products

customer_segment.value: B2B: pool builders, pool service and repair companies, landscape and irrigation contractors, retail pool stores

end_markets.value: residential and commercial pools; irrigation and landscaping; pool construction

revenue_model.value: product sales: pool chemicals, equipment, parts and supplies sold to trade customers

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys from equipment and chemical manufacturers, sells to pool professionals and retailers

geography_served.value: global: North America mainly, plus operations in Europe and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: pool chemicals, equipment, parts, irrigation and landscape products sharing the same trade customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branch sales centers and distribution centers serving local trade customers; direct sales: sales representatives calling on pool builders and service companies; online: online ordering platform for trade customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hazardous chemical storage and transport rules from DOT and EPA, plus pesticide registration for sanitizers
